record.bible_text: Whither is thy beloved<WH01730> gone<WH01980><WTH8804>, O thou fairest<WH03303> among women<WH0802>? whither is thy beloved<WH01730> turned aside<WH06437><WTH8804>? that we may seek<WH01245><WTH8762> him with thee.
